target.title: fix(telegram): preserve opening text on rich fallback retries
target.body:
Fixes #91383.
Refs #93059.

This replaces the stalled draft #93059 on current `main`.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Telegram users could receive a corrupted plain fallback reply when a rich/HTML parse failure happened near early Markdown links, causing the delivered message to start after the assistant reply's opening text.

The affected surface is Telegram text delivery, including the ordinary reply path and the durable send path.

## Why This Change Was Made

Rich parse-error fallback now carries a source-derived plain fallback through the Telegram rich chunk plan and uses that source chunk for parse-error retries instead of rebuilding fallback text from rendered rich HTML. The existing rendered-HTML fallback remains for rich entity validation cases so table-aware invalid-entity degradation keeps its current behavior.

The replacement also preserves the retry context on the plain fallback paths: link previews, silent sends, thread/reply parameters, and reply markup remain attached when Telegram rejects rich parsing.

## User Impact

Telegram replies that begin with prose and early Markdown links should keep their opening text when OpenClaw has to retry as plain text after a rich parse failure. Users with link previews disabled should keep that preference on the fallback retry as well.

## Evidence

- `pnpm dlx node@24.15.0 scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/send.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts` - 253 passed
- `pnpm dlx node@24.15.0 scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/telegram/src/rich-plain-fallback.ts extensions/telegram/src/rich-message.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.replies.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/draft-stream.ts` - passed
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/telegram/src/rich-plain-fallback.ts extensions/telegram/src/rich-message.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.replies.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/draft-stream.ts` - passed
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` - passed

Live Telegram behavior proof blocker: this environment has no `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `OPENCLAW_QA_TELEGRAM_*`, or Mantis Telegram credentials available, so I could not run a real Telegram bot/user proof locally. The repository has Mantis Telegram proof workflows, but triggering the credentialed visible-proof lane requires the maintainer workflow/label path rather than local credentials from this fork checkout.

AI-assisted: yes, implemented by Codex.
